notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is incorrect for return-trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The sanitized dispatch mapper (map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts) passes discount data straight from dispatch.report.price.discount into the email payload. The create-reservations mapper (create-reservations.mappers.ts) already has return-trip–specific logic (station swap, RETURN_TRIP_TAIL) but may not be adjusting the discount amount for return-trip line items, causing the wrong promo code amount to appear in the confirmation for those tickets.

notes: Openspec provided no acceptance criteria, only a root-cause analysis note. I created all ACs from scratch based on the defect description and openspec's root-cause notes. AC-1 is the core fix: return-trip discount must match the dispatch response. AC-2 ensures no regression on one-way bookings. AC-3 through AC-5 cover edge cases (no discount, full discount, zero discount). AC-6 addresses the scenario where outbound and return legs have different discount amounts — this is a likely edge case given the return-trip-specific logic mentioned in openspec's notes. AC-7 ensures consistency across email sections, preventing partial fixes. AC-8 covers fractional currency rounding, a common source of display discrepancies.
